title: MAID argument · five-act documentary
doctrine: Atmosphere film is not proof. Primary sources open on each act. Cinema LTX b-roll — no flags, no logos, no readable text.

beats.label: ACT I · Intent
beats.title: Intent to destroy
beats.text: Bill C-7 removed the reasonably foreseeable death safeguard. The intent sits on the parliamentary record — not on this film.
beats.narration: Act one. Intent. Bill C-7 removed the reasonably foreseeable death safeguard. The intent is on the parliamentary record. Open Act One for Hansard and statute sources. This film is atmosphere — not the proof.

beats.label: ACT II · Killing
beats.title: The killing fields
beats.text: Track 2 provisions and coroner files document non-terminal deaths. Numbers come from Health Canada and provincial records.
beats.narration: Act two. Killing fields. Track two provisions and coroner files document non-terminal deaths. Open Act Two for the tables. Film is not evidence.

beats.label: ACT III · Harm
beats.title: Bodily and mental harm
beats.text: Veterans Affairs cases, care denial, and serious harm on the public record. Walk the act for primary citations.
beats.narration: Act three. Bodily and mental harm. Veterans Affairs cases and care denial appear on the public record. Open Act Three for sources.

beats.label: ACT IV · Conditions
beats.title: Conditions calculated
beats.text: Poverty, housing instability, and palliative denial — conditions of life mapped from government series.
beats.narration: Act four. Conditions calculated to destroy. Poverty, housing instability, and palliative denial. Open Act Four for the charts and files.

beats.label: ACT V · Coercion
beats.title: Coercion of the vulnerable
beats.text: Death offered where care is withheld. Close the five-act board with sources — not this memorial loop alone.
beats.narration: Act five. Coercion of the vulnerable. Death offered where care is withheld. Open Act Five and the evidence shelf. You verify every claim.
